title: Shopping is moving to AI agents, and our store must be agent-ready
summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent payments; Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; Target reported an AI assistant sales lift. Tablet shipments fell 23% (Omdia); notebooks stay weak to Q2 2027; Walmart e-commerce grew 23%.

points.headline: AI agents are gaining the ability to discover and pay at retailer checkouts
points.detail: ChatGPT Wallet lets agents pay at merchants, Alexa for Shopping reached 15 countries and Target saw early sales lift. We should make our catalog and checkout ready for agent-initiated orders.

points.headline: PC and tablet demand is weak while memory and supply costs squeeze pricing
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 and notebooks are expected to stay weak through Q2 2027. Samsung memory costs rose 263%. We should plan inventory and promotions for price-led competition.

points.headline: Marketplaces are winning on discovery and delivery speed
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product online and Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% on fulfillment speed. We need accurate product data and competitive delivery promises on these channels.

points.headline: Small-business and holiday spending is strong for those who offer value
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers during the holiday window.
